summary: Completed frontend testing of Theme Toggle, Portion Presets, and Search Caching features. All features working as expected. Theme toggle switches between dark/light modes correctly with localStorage persistence across page navigation. Portion presets (¼, ½, 1, 1½, 2, 3, 4, 5) all present and update servings value correctly. Total calculation shows both protein and calories. Search caching works perfectly - cached search is ~105x faster with '(cached)' toast message.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme toggle feature fully tested - button at bottom of sidebar with Sun/Moon icon. Dark mode is default. Light mode applies white backgrounds and dark text. Theme persists in localStorage and across page navigation. Portion presets in Add to Log dialog: ¼, ½, 1, 1½, 2, 3, 4, 5 - all buttons have data-testid='portion-preset-{value}'. Search caching is client-side using a Map with 5-minute TTL. Cached results show '(cached)' in toast message. GlassCard component supports themed styling.
